message: 武士道と乙女道

name: Synn
message: 「Rie--」
It's rare to see Riesling-san on campus. I start to call out to him, only to hastily shut my mouth.
Come to think of it, the library is open to the general public on weekends. He must have come to borrow books on his personal time.
Riesling-san walks gracefully, turning the pages of a thick book as he goes.
What an unexpected side of him. He can't even wait to move to a proper spot to read at his leisure. I know that feeling all too well.
...What a great expression. I wish I could read books with a face like that too.

name: Shio
message: 「I have found you! I have awaited this encounter as though a single day were a thousand autumns!」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Butler, please cross blades with me!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sh-Shio-chan... You don't have to say things like Misa so out of the blue.」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, were you accompanying him as well, Lord Synn?」

name: Shio
message: 「Even a brushing of sleeves is a lifelong blunder! I beseech you to serve as referee!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What a pushy brat. That naginata girl is the spitting image of Hiss.」

name: Synn
message: 「Did she pick up those proverbs from Lolotte?」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Riesling-san, closing your book... Don't tell me you actually intend to fight?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Engaging in pointless combat with my young lady's schoolmates is not within the duties of this humble butler, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Shio
message: 「P-Pointless, you say?! How outrageous! I merely wish to borrow Lord Butler's strength so that I may reach the realm of true mastery!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Master Synn, Lady Shio, if you will excuse me.」

name: Shio
message: 「Gah, halt right there!」

name: Shio
message: 「Do you intend to flee?! You crucian-carp samurai, you potato samurai!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Riesling-san isn't a samurai in the first place.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, Shio-chan, what are you doing?! Isn't that a real blade?!」

name: Shio
message: 「There is no need for alarm?」

name: Shio
message: 「The Asukai naginata is a blade forged to subjugate demons. Even if it slashes a human, it is merely a bit dull and stings a little.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Aren't you saying something terribly dangerous?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hah!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Fwoah!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Nngh...」

name: Riesling
message: 「You are only the second person to block my surprise attack, Lady Shio」

name: Riesling
message: 「I acknowledge your natural gift. Now then--」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa...」
Holding a library book in one hand, Riesling executes a graceful leap.
Then, leaving behind an afterimage, he vanishes in the blink of an eye, completely disappearing from sight.

name: Paqy
message: 「Wait, is the butler actually a 'kunoichi' or something?」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, it was likely to evade my pursuit」

name: Shio
message: 「I deliberately interrupted his reading to challenge him to a match, yet... it seems he is not a gentleman who falls for such vulgar provocations...」

name: Shio
message: 「I must train harder so I can stand toe-to-toe with Old Jiiya!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. Don't you think it's better to take it easy and pace yourself?」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't need to be in such a rush, you'll be fine. Riesling even acknowledged your talent, Shio-chan」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, absolutely not! There are countless souls blessed with natural talent. Without honing oneself through rigorous training, one ends up as nothing more than a pebble by the roadside」

name: Shio
message: 「However... what you say also holds great truth, Lord Synn...」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh... to drop my beloved blade, Kogitsunemaru--how utterly pathetic...」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Shio-chan, are you hurt!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Ashamed as I am to admit it, I am unharmed」

name: Shio
message: 「It is merely that, well... both my hands are numb, and my knees are trembling... In this state, I can hardly claim to have blocked Old Jiiya's thrust」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll carry your naginata. I just put it in the bag, right?」

name: Shio
message: 「You have my gratitude」

name: Shio
message: 「Um... while I am imposing on your kindness, might you also lend me your shoulder? I wish to head to the martial arts hall」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, sure thing」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh? Where are you going, Lord Synn? That is not the direction of the martial arts hall」

name: Synn
message: 「Didn't you just say my words had a point? Let's take a break in the courtyard. This time of year, sitting on a bench and looking up at the sky feels amazing」

name: Shio
message: 「Sir Synn...」

name: Shio
message: 「Understood. As soon as I have recovered, I shall immediately challenge you to a rematch」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, I didn't say anything like that」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm. What sort of training must I undergo to earn Sir Jeeves's interest...」

name: Synn
message: 「She's not even listening」
Setting aside the current gap in skill between the two of them, Riesling exchanges witty banter with Lolotte and offers polite greetings to the rest of us.
However, her behavior toward Shio is the sole exception, falling into neither category.

name: Shio
message: 「Oh! How careless of me. Sir Synn, I implore you to keep my earlier blunder a secret from Lady Sister!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I promise」
Shio probably hasn't noticed Riesling's attitude toward her.
I wasn't entirely sure why myself, but I didn't point it out.

name: Helena
message: 「Perhaps Shio wants a rival」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena?! Um... because she's Misa's cousin?」

name: Helena
message: 「That might be part of it... but I think she feels she can't stay as she is if she wants to grow stronger」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, you might be able to offer her emotional support」

name: Synn
message: 「Me, support Shio...?」

name: Helena
message: 「That girl is bound by her duty as well... It's a shame, especially when she's right at that tender age」

name: Synn
message: 「Does that... include us too?」

name: Helena
message: 「Who knows~? There might be others as well\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「We're pretty much allowed to do as we please」

name: Helena
message: 「That's true. Even so, I believe Shio has dreams of her own」
For what it's worth, I'm also burdened with the duty of being the Demon Lord.
Even so, I have a dream of living a sparkling school life.
So far, I think I've managed to balance both. Though it'll all be over if I'm found out.

name: Helena
message: 「Please teach her how to live without being bound solely by her duty. You can do that, can't you?」
I wonder if Helena has seen right through what my duty actually is.
However, if possible, I also want to cooperate with Shio-chan as comrades in the Student Council... the Crusaders.
And together, we'll spend a sparkling school life.

name: Synn
message: 「...Understood. I'll try my best, as much as I can!」

name: Helena
message: 「Very well! As a reward, I'll give you this trophy.」

name: Helena
message: 「Also, make sure to teach them not to go wild in the library, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes...」
